visualCharacteristics.purpose: Brightcove video poster under a navy scrim with optional title / description and a "Watch m:ss" control that loads the player in place
visualCharacteristics.layout: 16:9 stage; content centered over the poster
visualCharacteristics.notes: Title and description are optional (label-only bands in split-section columns). Without a player URL the poster renders alone, with no scrim and no control.

contentPattern.structure: rows classified by content: <picture> poster; text paragraphs (title, description - both optional - and the "Watch m:ss" play label); Brightcove player URL paragraph(s), first = player, second = fallback

usage: Video bands and in-column video posters.
reuseGuidance: Author the play label as "Watch m:ss"; leave title/description out for a compact in-column poster.
